questions: Are your repeated leg and foot movements involuntary or difficult for you to control?
Do you feel an uncomfortable urge to move your legs before the movements occur?
Does moving your legs temporarily relieve that discomfort or urge?
Are these symptoms worse when you are sitting or lying still?
Are they worse in the evening or at night?
Do these movements interfere with falling asleep or staying asleep?
Do the symptoms affect both legs, even if one side is worse?
Have you had these symptoms for more than three months?
Have the symptoms recently become more frequent or severe?
Do you experience cramping, pain, burning, tingling, or crawling sensations in your legs?
Do you have weakness or numbness in either leg?
Do you have back pain that radiates into either leg?
Have you had any loss of bladder or bowel control?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed the dose of any medication?
Do you take medication for depression, anxiety, psychosis, nausea, or sleep?
Have you recently taken medication such as metoclopramide, prochlorperazine, haloperidol, risperidone, or another antipsychotic?
Do you feel restless throughout your whole body rather than only in your legs?
Do your movements continue when you are asleep?
Do you have a history of anemia, kidney disease, diabetes, thyroid disease, or pregnancy?
Does anyone in your family have similar nighttime leg symptoms?
